api_key.description: The Algolia API key. Either this and app_id must be set, or applications must be set.

app_id.description: The Algolia application ID. Either this and api_key must be set, or applications must be set.

applications.description: Algolia applications to use. Either this must be set, or api_key and app_id must be set.

name.description: The application name. Will be linked to the component with the same name and must be a valid Terraform provider alias.
